title: Unlocking the Full Value of Microsoft Security: Defender, Sentinel & Your Microsoft Licensing
summary: Strengthen your Microsoft security strategy with Xerox IT Solutions. Explore Defender, Sentinel and Microsoft 365 E3 and E5 security capabilities.
body_markdown:
## Defender, Sentinel & Your Microsoft Licensing


Are you getting the full value from your Microsoft security investment? Join[Xerox® IT Solutions](https://www.xerox.com/en-us/services/it-solutions) for a practical discussion on Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, and the security capabilities available within Microsoft 365 E3 and E5. Learn how organizations are improving threat detection, response, and security operations while maximizing the value of the Microsoft technologies they already own. Explore common security gaps, opportunities for improvement, and next steps for building a stronger Microsoft security strategy.


### Unlocking the Full Value of Microsoft Security October 27, 2026 at 11:00 AM CST


60-Minute Live Session + Q&A


### What you'll learn


-


The security capabilities available within Microsoft 365 E3 and E5, and how to determine whether you're fully utilizing what you already own.


-


How Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Sentinel work together to improve threat detection, investigation, response, and security operations.


-


The differences between foundational Microsoft security capabilities and advanced security operations tools.


-


Real-world examples of underutilized Microsoft security investments and opportunities to improve protection, visibility, and value realization.


Register now
